stories.title: Saudi delegation attends 57th GCC Industrial Cooperation Committee meeting in Bahrain

en.title: Saudi delegation attends 57th GCC Industrial Cooperation Committee meeting in Bahrain
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's delegation, headed by the CEO of the Saudi Industrial Development Fund, participated in the 57th GCC Industrial Cooperation Committee meeting in Manama to discuss industrial sector issues among member states.

stories.title: Egyptian FM, Arab League chief call Prince Faisal to condemn Houthi attacks

en.title: Egyptian FM, Arab League chief call Prince Faisal to condemn Houthi attacks
en.summary: Egypt's Foreign Minister and Arab League Secretary General called Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister to condemn Houthi attacks on airports in Abha and Riyadh, expressing regional solidarity against the destabilizing threat.

stories.title: Arab League, UN condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab League, UN condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Arab League's secretary-general condemned continuing Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia in a call with the Saudi foreign minister, discussing regional security and the league's response to ongoing challenges.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia and UAE agree to strengthen power grid and rail connectivity

en.title: Saudi Arabia and UAE agree to strengthen power grid and rail connectivity
en.summary: Saudi Arabia and the UAE signed a memorandum of understanding to enhance cooperation on power grid interconnection, electricity exchange, and rail connectivity to deepen regional integration and improve energy efficiency.

stories.title: France and several countries, organizations condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: France and several countries, organizations condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: France joined multiple Arab and Islamic nations and organizations in condemning repeated Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia, expressing solidarity with the Kingdom and calling for an immediate cessation of the attacks that destabilize the region.

en.title: Moroccan conjoined twins separated successfully
en.summary: A Saudi medical team successfully separated 13-month-old Moroccan conjoined twins Saja and Duha at King Abdullah Specialist Children's Hospital in Riyadh as part of the Saudi Conjoined Twins Program.

stories.title: Saudi Relief Flight Lands in Nepal to Aid Flood Victims

en.title: Saudi Relief Flight Lands in Nepal to Aid Flood Victims
en.summary: A Saudi relief aircraft delivered humanitarian assistance to Nepal following recent flooding in the country.

stories.title: Arab Parliament President Stresses Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Pose Direct Threat to Regional Security

en.title: Arab Parliament President Stresses Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Pose Direct Threat to Regional Security
en.summary: The Arab Parliament President characterized Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia as posing a direct threat to regional security.

stories.title: King Salman Sends Invitation to UAE President to Participate in Second GCC-EU Summit

en.title: King Salman Sends Invitation to UAE President to Participate in Second GCC-EU Summit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Salman has invited the UAE President to participate in the Second GCC-EU Summit.

stories.title: Saudi relief plane lands in Nepal to succor flood victims

en.title: Saudi relief plane lands in Nepal to succor flood victims
en.summary: A Saudi relief aircraft carrying humanitarian supplies arrived in Kathmandu to assist people affected by recent flooding in Nepal, with distribution coordinated by the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center.

stories.title: Civil Defense: Debris from Intercepted Houthi Missile Damages Kindergarten and Clinic Complex in Riyadh

en.title: Civil Defense: Debris from Intercepted Houthi Missile Damages Kindergarten and Clinic Complex in Riyadh
en.summary: Debris from an intercepted Houthi missile caused damage to a kindergarten and clinic complex in Riyadh, according to the Civil Defense authority.

stories.title: UAE Strongly Condemns Houthi Militia Attacks on King Khalid, Abha International Airports

en.title: UAE Strongly Condemns Houthi Militia Attacks on King Khalid, Abha International Airports
en.summary: The UAE issued a strong condemnation of Houthi militia attacks targeting King Khalid and Abha International Airports.

stories.title: ‎Ceer opens first mobile store in Diriyah, launches EXOBOT First Edition reservations

en.title: Ceer opens first mobile store in Diriyah, launches EXOBOT First Edition reservations
en.summary: Saudi Arabian automaker Ceer opened its first retail location at Bujairi Terrace in Diriyah to showcase domestically manufactured EXOBOT vehicles. The store accepts reservations for the limited-edition EXOBOT First Edition sedan and SUV, each priced at SAR 399,000 with warranty and service coverage included.

stories.title: ‎Aramco, NESR sign $200M deal for lithium project in Saudi Arabia

en.title: Aramco, NESR sign $200M deal for lithium project in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Saudi Aramco and NESR have agreed on a $200 million contract to develop a pilot lithium production project targeting 2,000 metric tons of annual battery-grade lithium carbonate output beginning in late 2027. The initiative combines Aramco's subsurface knowledge with NESR's Lithara technology platform for lithium extraction.

stories.title: ‎Saudi foreign reserve assets fall 4% to SAR 1.75T in September

en.title: Saudi foreign reserve assets fall 4% to SAR 1.75T in September
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's foreign reserve assets decreased by SAR 81.1 billion to SAR 1.75 trillion in September, marking a 4% monthly decline, though year-over-year reserves rose 3%. Foreign currency reserves, representing approximately 95% of total assets, increased 4% annually to SAR 1.65 trillion.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Oct. 6
en.summary: The Tadawul stock exchange is reporting significant changes in ownership occurring on October 6.

stories.title: ‎eXtra sees continued sales growth in Q4

en.title: eXtra sees continued sales growth in Q4
en.summary: United Electronics Co. expects sales growth to continue in Q4 2026, supported by seasonal shopping demand, product variety, and multiple distribution channels. The company is preparing with adequate inventory levels to meet anticipated customer demand.
